intent: Technical Brief: ASUS TUF Gaming A15 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to inadequate cooling system
suggested_solution: Regular Cleaning of vents, fans, and heat pipes for proper airflow.
Proper Cooling by using the laptop in a well-ventilated area, away from direct sunlight or other heat sources.
Thermal Monitoring using software tools to adjust usage patterns accordingly.
